sloka: तस्य तं रथमास्थाय हनूमान् मारुतत्मजः ।प्रममाथ तलेनाशु सह तेनैव रक्षसा ।। ६.४३.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: tasya taṁ rathamāsthāya hanūmān mārutatmajaḥ ।pramamātha talenāśu saha tenaiva rakṣasā ।। 6.43.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman the son of wind god, getting on to the chariot quickly destroyed that Rakshasa Jambumali with his palm.
